subject: Kernel SRE seat — pro-forma offer & conditional approval
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: talentry-recruiting <recruiting@talentry.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Kernel SRE seat — provisional approval requested

Team,

We have a candidate (internal referral) for a Kernel SRE role on the runtime infra squad who can start Q3 if we lock an offer this week. Hiring manager has asked for a pro-forma offer so People Ops can fast-track background checks and payroll setup. I am requesting a conditional headcount approval to:

- Reserve 1 FTE slot in the infra budget for Q3 (location: SF)
- Approve pro-forma comp band alignment (L4/L5 mix, see attached matrix)
- Allow offer to include a 3-month deferred equity vesting clause aligned with recent comp guidance

Why this is time-sensitive: the candidate has an existing counteroffer window through next Tuesday. If we miss that, ramp shifts into Q4 and we lose a critical kernel optimization delivery for our early-autoscaling push.

Attached: infra_comp_matrix_q3.xlsx (comp bands & pro-forma totals); pro-forma-offer-template.pdf

Ask: please reply with a greenlight or clear rejection by EOD Monday so I can coordinate with Recruiting and Finance. If you need an alternate cost center, flag it here and I will reallocate.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, talentry-recruiting <recruiting@talentry.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Kernel SRE seat — provisional approval requested

Hannah — thanks for the note and the attachments. Quick clarifying questions before I sign off:

1) Comp funding source — is this from the existing "Kernel Optimization" tranche (Q3) or do you need a one-time transfer from Platform Ops reserves? The matrix labels both options but not a recommended path.
2) Equity deferral language — People Ops prefers not to have non-standard vesting triggers in pro-formas. Can we document this as an internal note to be discussed at offer stage rather than baked into the template?
3) If we approve now, do we need any upfront spend (signing bonus) that Finance needs to pre-authorize?

If the answers are: tranche = Kernel Optimization; equity = internal note; signing bonus = up to $10k, I can approve a provisional slot now. If there's anything beyond that I need Marcus to OK the compensating reallocation.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
VP, Talent & Compensation
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, talentry-recruiting <recruiting@talentry.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 14:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Kernel SRE seat — provisional approval requested

On Fri, Jul 28, 2028 at 11:08 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hannah — thanks for the note and the attachments. Quick clarifying questions before I sign off:
>
> 1) Comp funding source — is this from the existing "Kernel Optimization" tranche (Q3) or do you need a one-time transfer from Platform Ops reserves?
> 2) Equity deferral language — People Ops prefers not to have non-standard vesting triggers in pro-formas.
> 3) If we approve now, do we need any upfront spend (signing bonus) that Finance needs to pre-authorize?

Hannah — I support a provisional approval with the following conditions:

- Confirm funding from Kernel Optimization tranche; if not available, we'll cover through a one-time intra-org transfer but I need a stub cost-center change request by Monday.
- No non-standard legal language in the pro-forma. If Recruiting needs the equity deferral as a negotiation tactic, mark it as an "offer discussion note."
- Signing bonus: up to $10,000 OK; any amount above requires Finance sign-off.
- If the candidate expects start-date relocation assistance, route to Greenline Payroll for pre-approval (CC'd).

Alternative (if tranche is tight): convert a contractor slot (platform-kernel-contractor-12) into a provisional 3-month FTE; that would be budget neutral for Q3. Hannah — can you confirm whether that conversion is workable for the team?

I'll mark this as approved contingent on the items above.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Engineering, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: talentry-recruiting <recruiting@talentry.com>, greenline-payroll <payroll@greenline.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Kernel SRE seat — provisional approval requested

Thanks, Marcus and Kimberly — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming actions from my side:

- Funding: Kernel Optimization tranche confirmed. I attached an updated line in infra_comp_matrix_q3.xlsx that shows the reallocation.
- Pro-forma template: will remove non-standard vesting language and add an "offer negotiation note" field for Recruiting. pro-forma-offer-template.pdf updated and resent to Recruiting.
- Signing bonus: capped at $10k. Recruiting will not promise anything above that without Finance sign-off.
- Contractor conversion: we will NOT convert contractor-12; pulling that contractor would delay an on-call handover. So we prefer the tranche fund.
- Payroll: CC'd Greenline to start pre-onboarding steps if we need relocation or tax paperwork.

Next steps:
- Kimberly: if this still looks good, please reply with one-line approve so I can instruct Recruiting to extend the pro-forma.
- Recruiting: please prepare the pro-forma and an initial offer script; hold until Kimberly's one-line.
- Finance/Payroll: please note possible sign-on payment and potential relocation pre-approval.

I'll hold candidate window updates in a calendar invite and ping if things change.

Thanks again —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
